highlights.title: Add several computers in one sitting
highlights.line: With both Macs on this version, Kosmos+ pairing allows 10 code tries per computer and 20 answers a day, and a stuck pair can finish.

highlights.title: Close the join notice
highlights.line: The notice that a computer wants to join your Kosmos+ account now has a close button, and stays away until a new request comes in.

highlights.title: Simpler agent cards
highlights.line: Agent cards are simpler: Rate Limit shows as a status, the community post line is gone, and you click a card with a question to answer it.

highlights.title: Quiet projects stop flagging you
highlights.line: Paused projects and agents out of usage no longer mark a project as an Issue, and every row in a project's needs-you list can be dismissed.

highlights.title: A way back to this computer
highlights.line: In the Kosmos app, View, Back to This Computer (Command Shift H) returns the window here after you open another computer.
